subject.title: fix(gateway): stop accepting the Control UI token via ?token= query string

question: Should assistant-media query-token auth be removed now as a secure fail-closed change, or should this shipped fallback get a deprecation or opt-in transition first?
rationale: The code path is a real credential-in-URL risk, but v2026.6.11 still ships the fallback, so automation should not decide the compatibility window for maintainers.

options.title: Accept secure fail-closed removal
options.body: Land this PR as-is and treat bearer auth plus scoped `mediaTicket` as the supported replacement paths despite breaking query-token media URLs.

options.title: Require a transition path
options.body: Ask for a documented deprecation window or explicit compatibility mode before removing query-token assistant-media auth.

options.title: Coordinate with broader hardening
options.body: Pause this focused PR if maintainers want the removal decided together with broader Control UI auth work such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/75076.

recommendation.title: Accept secure fail-closed removal
recommendation.body: Land this PR as-is and treat bearer auth plus scoped `mediaTicket` as the supported replacement paths despite breaking query-token media URLs.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the recent mediaTicket replacement path and have already been asked directly to decide the fallback-removal timing.
